description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController that provides basic endpoints for health checks, documentation redirection, and a welcome message.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic application endpoints including health check, documentation redirect, and welcome message.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application info.
